definitions.explanation: A product label meaning 'salt has been added.' Most commonly seen on butter, where {有塩|ゆうえん}バター is the default supermarket variety; contrasts with {無塩|むえん} (unsalted).

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有塩|ゆうえん}⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use salted butter for cooking.

examples.japanese: {有塩|ゆうえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{無塩|むえん}→無塩：28595_muen⟧、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}います→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Are you buying salted or unsalted?

examples.japanese: ⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧{作|づく}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無塩|むえん}→無塩：28595_muen⟧⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有塩|ゆうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Unsalted butter is the standard for baking, but at home many people use salted instead.

notes:
Compound of {有|ゆう} (have/with) + {塩|えん} (salt; えん in compounds, しお on its own). Used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or directly attached as a prefix-style label.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有塩|ゆうえん}⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧: salted butter
- {有塩|ゆうえん}⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: salted food product
- {有塩|ゆうえん}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: salt-added processing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無塩|むえん}→無塩：28595_muen⟧: unsalted — the direct opposite
- {加塩|かえん}: salt-added (less common label, similar meaning)
- ⟦{減塩|げんえん}→減塩：21843_genen⟧: reduced-salt — salt is reduced but still present
